seed: Assume positions live on a lattice. Infer the step size and bounds from the data and write movement as lattice moves with explicit bound and obstacle checks.

synth.notes:
Player moves on a 3-cell lattice over floor colours {1,4} inside the portal bbox (step/bounds inferred); next rect overlapping a block = kick, player stays.
Kicked chain slides 1 cell/tick over {1,4,15} with closure; stopped by walls, board edge, player, or a non-fitting socket interior (inset 1).
Click on a block: player takes that block rect; old player left as an inert husk (rim e, centre 4); sides touching blocks drawn 0.
Background under movers: socket border 4 / interior 1, else majority of nearest uncovered cell in 4 dirs.
HUD row 63 zeros = ceil(k/2), k = actions this level, continuity-gated (fallback 2z-1); fitting-socket entry unconfirmed.
